messages:
oliver: Morning folks! Quick ask 0min run to the farmer's market — anyone want bananas or Greek yogurt? I'll be back by 10.

priya: If you're there can you grab a small jar of peanut butter? The one in the cabinet is basically a relic. :eyes: 

maya: Also can we restock the decaf? Some teammates only do decaf in the afternoon.

ocarlos: I can pick up bananas + decaf. Do we prefer whole-bean or ground for the drip?

emma: Whole-bean if possible. Grinder works best with fresh. Also new request: please don't leave open condiment jars on the counter. Someone found jam ants yesterday. :ant: :cry: 

oliver: noted re ants. I'll tape a "SEAL AFTER USE" note on the jam jar. 

priya: tagging @kitchen-bot to set a reminder for label stickers :)
kitchen-bot: reminder created: "Kitchen labels + seal jars" at 11:00 AM tomorrow.

maya: Small poll: yogurt flavors — plain, vanilla, or strawberry? Reply with 1/2/3.

emma: 1

priya: 2

ocarlos: 3 (strawberry please)

oliver: going with the consensus: plain + one strawberry pack.

oliver: quick buy list I put on my phone:
```
- Bananas (bunch)
- Stumptown Decaf whole-bean 12oz
- Greek yogurt plain x6 cups
- Peanut butter small jar
- Sandwich bags + sticky labels
```

maya: Also can we agree on a "one-crumb rule" for the microwave? If you spill, wipe it. I'll bring a small bottle of surface cleaner.

emma: agree. i'll write it on the whiteboard: "1 crumb = 1 wipe" :memo:

priya: Venmo for market goods ok? I'm happy to chip in for the beans.
oliver: Venmo works. Send to @oliver-redwood and I'll drop a receipt photo in #kitchen-photos.

carlos: thanks all. I'll stash one emergency instant coffee sachet in the top cabinet labeled "Do Not Use Unless Panic" :sweat_smile:

kitchen-bot: note saved: "Emergency instant coffee 1 sachet" added to inventory.

oliver: Perfect. Back in an hour. If anyone needs anything else DM me.
